provenance: Repo-local descriptor (the publisher's own repo). Context and the allowed backends come from the repo's litertlm_manifest.json (it lists gpu and cpu for the int4 file and cpu for the int8 file; the int4 variant gets a gpu profile only, see below). A looped normalized-GPT reasoning model (NVIDIA's Dory1.0-4B; its 20 recurrent attention/MLP pairs run twice per token): the bundle declares the thought channel (<think> / </think>) and its generation prompt opens it (<think> then a newline), so the model reasons from its first token; with thinking off the template closes the block at once (<think></think>). handler_config.channels spells the bundle's channel and thinking_default is true. The bundle's KV budget is 2,048 tokens for prompt and reply together. int4 is the GPU file and int8 the CPU file, as the card says (on a CPU the int4 file is the wrong choice): int4 has a gpu profile only and int8 a cpu profile only, so on a phone whose GPU path does not load the model (none of the GPU builds the publisher ran fitted the 8 GB Pixel 8a, and the int4 file itself was not run there, the card) the app requests variant int8 itself, ModelRef(id, variant = "int8"): Auto never switches variants. The repo's manifest sets min_runtime_version 0.18.0 for both files: the earliest runtime the publisher verified them on (they were also packed with that builder version), not a floor the runtime enforces. runtime_range starts at 0.16.1, the runtime this SDK links; the run below shows that runtime loading and answering with both files. On 2026-10-22 a Galaxy S26 (SM-S942Q, Android 16) ran both variants on litertlm-android 0.16.1 in samples/chat's ChatDeviceCheck at this repository's commit 5e497ba, the files downloaded from the Hub on the phone: int4 on the GPU answered 17 + 25 with "42" and the model card's "Extract the dates from: The meeting moved from May 3 to May 17." with "May 3, May 17" (thinking on, each thought closed, after 369 and 1,939 characters of reasoning, 107 and 565 tokens by the model's tokenizer; the runtime put every node of the prefill and decode graphs on its GPU delegate), and int8 on the CPU answered "42" (480 characters of thought, 137 tokens). Neither profile has a gate run or a verification record.
